snippet.title: Afterlight Survival - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
You have until dark.

Scavenge, craft, and fortify. Find the cure before they erase the evidence.

Open-world zombie survival horror, up to 4 players.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4546540/Afterlight?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social
